mapper.sql:
FROM public.nw_runtime_knowledge_sources s JOIN public.nw_knowledge_document_versions v ON v.tenant_id=s.source_tenant_id AND v.kb_id=s.source_base_id AND v.source_version=s.source_version AND v.chunk_set_id=s.chunk_set_id JOIN public.nw_knowledge_document_contents c ON c.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND c.document_id=v.document_id AND c.id=v.content_id JOIN public.nw_knowledge_documents document ON document.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND document.kb_id=v.kb_id AND document.id=v.document_id AND document.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND s.binding_id=b.binding_id AND v.status='ready' AND (s.source_id,s.source_version) IN
(#{version.sourceId},#{version.sourceVersion})
AND v.created_at<=#{scope.asOf} AND b.published_at<=#{scope.asOf} AND (#{scope.freshness,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}::timestamptz IS NULL OR v.created_at>=#{scope.freshness,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}::timestamptz)
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, binding_id, target_digest, handle, descriptor_id, descriptor_revision, capability_id, version_id, descriptor_json, source_count, published_at FROM public.nw_runtime_knowledge_bindings WHERE tenant_id=current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) AND binding_id=#{id}

SELECT c.descriptor::text AS descriptor_json,r.published_at FROM public.nw_knowledge_base_revisions r JOIN public.nw_knowledge_bases b ON b.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND b.id=r.kb_id JOIN public.nw_capability_versions c ON c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND c.id=r.capability_version_id WHERE r.tenant_id::text=#{tenant} AND r.kb_id::text=#{target.descriptorId} AND r.revision=#{target.descriptorRevision} AND r.status IN ('published','archived') AND r.published_at IS NOT NULL AND b.status='active' AND c.id::text=#{target.capability.versionId} AND c.definition_id::text=#{target.capability.capabilityId} AND c.capability_type='KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE' AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.descriptor-'link_follow_up'=(r.capability_policy || jsonb_build_object('source_id',r.kb_id::text,'source_versions',r.source_versions)) AND (NOT jsonb_exists(c.descriptor,'link_follow_up') OR jsonb_typeof(c.descriptor->'link_follow_up')='object') AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(r.capability_policy))=5 AND jsonb_exists_all(r.capability_policy,ARRAY['model_invocable','user_invocable','allowed_operators','freshness_policy','citation_required']) AND jsonb_typeof(r.capability_policy->'model_invocable')='boolean' AND jsonb_typeof(r.capability_policy->'user_invocable')='boolean' AND jsonb_typeof(r.capability_policy->'citation_required')='boolean' AND jsonb_typeof(r.capability_policy->'freshness_policy')='string' AND btrim(r.capability_policy->>'freshness_policy')<>'' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.source_versions) v WHERE jsonb_typeof(v)<>'string') AND ARRAY(SELECT v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(r.source_versions) v ORDER BY v)= ARRAY[#{version.sourceVersion}]::text[] AND ARRAY(SELECT v FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(r.capability_policy->'allowed_operators') v ORDER BY v)= ARRAY[#{operator}]::text[] FOR UPDATE OF b
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nw_runtime_knowledge_sources(tenant_id,binding_id,source_id,source_version,chunk_count,chunk_set_id) SELECT #{tenant},#{id},#{version.sourceId},#{version.sourceVersion},v.chunk_count,v.chunk_set_id FROM public.nw_knowledge_document_versions v WHERE v.tenant_id::text=#{tenant} AND v.kb_id::text=#{version.sourceId} AND v.source_version=#{version.sourceVersion} AND v.status='ready' AND v.chunk_count>0 AND v.chunk_count=(SELECT count(*) FROM public.knowledge_chunk_values c WHERE c.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND c.document_id=v.document_id AND c.source_version=v.source_version AND c.created_at IS NOT NULL AND c.chunk_index>=0)

INSERT INTO public.nw_runtime_knowledge_chunks(tenant_id,binding_id,source_id,source_version,document_id,chunk_id,chunk_index,created_at,chunk_set_id) SELECT #{tenant},#{id},c.kb_id::text,c.source_version,c.document_id::text,c.id::text,c.chunk_index,c.created_at,c.chunk_set_id FROM public.knowledge_chunk_values c JOIN public.nw_knowledge_document_versions v ON v.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND v.kb_id=c.kb_id AND v.document_id=c.document_id AND v.source_version=c.source_version JOIN public.nw_runtime_knowledge_sources s ON s.tenant_id=c.tenant_id::text AND s.source_id=c.kb_id::text AND s.source_version=c.source_version WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.binding_id=#{id} AND v.status='ready' AND c.created_at IS NOT NULL AND c.chunk_index>=0
mapper.select: SELECT s.source_id,s.source_version,s.chunk_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.nw_runtime_knowledge_chunks c WHERE c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND c.binding_id=s.binding_id AND c.source_id=s.source_id AND c.source_version=s.source_version) AS actual_count FROM public.nw_runtime_knowledge_sources s WHERE s.tenant_id=current_setting('app.tenant_id',true) AND s.binding_id=#{id}
